tagline: International Association Representing Interests in Inland Navigation
hero_kpi_rationale: Non-profit organization with no publicly available financial data. Member engagement and participation in annual congresses are the primary performance indicators available in the activity report.

kpis.name: Participation au Congres Annuel
kpis.explanation: Number of members and stakeholders participating in the annual IVR Congress
kpis.description: The 2024 Congress in Frankfurt welcomed 225 participants representing 11 European countries. This event remains the organization's annual highlight.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement and international participation

kpis.name: Nombre de Pays Membres
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in the IVR membership and participation
kpis.description: At the 2024 Congress, IVR brought together representatives from 11 different European countries, confirming its geographic reach and role as an international platform.

kpis.name: Participants au Colloque de Prevention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of industry professionals attending the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium event
kpis.description: The first Loss Prevention Colloquium, held in November 2024 in Antwerp, attracted approximately 80 professionals from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany, representing insurers, brokers, surveyors, and shipowners.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new flagship educational and networking event

kpis.name: Résultat net
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Indicator tracked annually, historical values available for the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Net income of €1.55 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Résultat opérationnel
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Operating income of €1.98 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total des actifs
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €19.65 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Dette totale
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €1.28 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Trésorerie & équivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of €2.6 Bn in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related digital technologies in the 2024 annual report. IVR focuses on regulatory alignment, technical standards, and industry knowledge exchange.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, or algorithmic capabilities
Focus on traditional committee work (ZKR, CESNI) and standards harmonization
Digitalization mentioned only in context of professional qualifications and regulatory frameworks, not as core organizational capability
